import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2000;
    static final int MAXG = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
    static int[][] gridA = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
    static int[][] gridB = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] exitList = new ArrayList[MAXG][MAXG];

    static int[] dRow = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dCol = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class Matching {
        int[] leftMatch = new int[MAXN];
        int[] rightMatch = new int[MAXN];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
        int matchedCount;

        int compute(int n, ArrayList<Integer> adjList[]) {
            matchedCount = 0;
            Arrays.fill(leftMatch, -1);
            Arrays.fill(rightMatch, -1);
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
                if (augment(u, adjList)) ++matchedCount;
            }
            return matchedCount;
        }

        private boolean augment(int u, ArrayList<Integer> adjList[]) {
            for (int v : adjList[u]) {
                if (visited[v]) continue;
                visited[v] = true;
                if (rightMatch[v] == -1 || augment(rightMatch[v], adjList)) {
                    leftMatch[u] = v;
                    rightMatch[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static void bfsFrom(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXG; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXG; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dRow[i], nc = c + dCol[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < MAXG && nc >= 0 && nc < MAXG &&
                    gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && dist[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void expandFrom(int sr, int sc, int cnt, int T, int[] nodeIdx) {
        int[][] vis = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXG; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], -1);
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        vis[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            if (vis[r][c] > Math.min(T, dist[r][c])) continue;
            for (int e : exitList[r][c]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {
                    adj[nodeIdx[0] + k].add(e);
                }
            }
            if (vis[r][c] == Math.min(T, dist[r][c])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dRow[i], nc = c + dCol[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < MAXG && nc >= 0 && nc < MAXG &&
                    gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && vis[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    vis[nr][nc] = vis[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        nodeIdx[0] += cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXG; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXG; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = -1;
                gridB[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXG; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXG; j++) {
                exitList[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int startR = -1, startC = -1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) gridA[i][j] = c - '0';
                if (c == 'Z') { startR = i; startC = j; }
            }
        }

        bfsFrom(startR, startC);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) gridB[i][j] = c - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < gridB[i][j]; ++k) {
                    exitList[i][j].add(exitList[i][j].size());
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXG; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXG; ++j)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = INF;

        int[] nodeCount = {0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0) expandFrom(i, j, gridA[i][j], T, nodeCount);

        Matching solver = new Matching();
        System.out.println(solver.compute(nodeCount[0], adj));
    }
}
